grades: Grades 4 to 12 per the program site; the state military page says grades 6 to 12
name: California Cadet Corps (school based leadership program)
org: California Cadet Corps, California Military Department
what_you_do: This is a school class or after school program. Cadets lead their peers, plan events and serve their community. They learn citizenship, leadership and wellness. Events include drill, summer camp and leadership conferences.
who_can_apply: Students at a school that runs a California Cadet Corps unit. Participation is voluntary. The pages read do not say how a student enrolls beyond being at a host school.
pay_detail: Free. The program site says it is fully funded by the state with no cost to families or host schools. Cadets earn up to ten elective credits per year.
deadline_text: No dates. Enrollment follows your school's schedule.
how_to_apply: Ask your school whether it has a Cadet Corps unit. The program site says schools that want to start one should email Recruiting@cacadets.org. The site's Contact Us page is cacadets.org/about/contact.
notes: Pages read did not include a school finder, so the best first step is to ask your school office or email the program. The program site says more than 7,000 students are in over 100 schools.
